column3: Outdated: the ruling (published 2021-07-23, Adventures in the Forgotten Realms) was written under the damage assignment order of CR 510.1c (CR effective 2021-07-23: "If two or more creatures are blocking it, it assigns its combat damage to those creatures according to the damage assignment order announced for it. ... However, it can't assign combat damage to a creature that's blocking it unless, when combat damage assignments are complete, each creature that precedes that blocking creature in its order is assigned lethal damage.", still so in the CR effective 2024-09-20). The CR effective 2024-11-08 (Magic Foundations) removed the damage assignment order (510.1c: "If two or more creatures are blocking it, it assigns its combat damage to those creatures divided as its controller chooses among them."; archived CR texts, github.com/pit142857/mtg-cr), so a creature blocked by several creatures needn't assign lethal damage to one before dealing damage to another. Only this part is outdated: Poison Breath still isn't deathtouch, so a creature with trample assigns lethal damage (the blocker's toughness) before trampling over (CR 702.19b), which stays cited and tested (tests/rulings/r_p048_dnd.rs, green_dragons_poison_breath_outlasts_it_and_isnt_deathtouch); the current division is tested in green_dragons_poison_breath_with_damage_divided_among_blockers; logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md
